svg.title: Prime and LED breakout: complete boards and ten-core cable
svg.desc: Whole Prime artwork, unchanged inherited cable paths, and complete v18 led artwork. All ten remote contact projections match native PCB pad centres. Seven indicators are onboard; source links do not establish their fitted state. Plug body/mating orientation and all-source-paint clearance remain unverified.
